intro: The giant rodent versus the sheriff!
description:
Forget being a peaceful pet; today, you're a destructive intruder. You are a giant rodent breaking into the sheriff's house. Your objective is simple: cause as much property damage as possible without getting caught.

Waddle through a highly interactive house and use your size to your advantage. Push over heavy TVs, break expensive vases, and smash the furniture. Open the refrigerator door to steal food, jump on kitchen tables, and drive the sheriff's guard dog crazy. When the owner walks in, quickly hide in a closet to avoid capture. Then, jump out and continue your rampage! From the backyard to the living room, make the sheriff's home your personal playground.

Key Features:
• Interactive Destruction: Shatter household objects, knock over electronics, and toss furniture with amusing physics-based movement.
• Fridge Raiding: Search the kitchen to steal snacks, sausages, and fresh vegetables directly from the cabinets and refrigerator.
• Evade the Sheriff: Dodge the homeowner and his guard dog by hiding in closets and sneaking through different rooms.
• Explore the house. Run wild from the grassy backyard to the master bedroom and leave a trail of chaos in your wake.
